name: Sashframe
description: A frame with one bar across it and one down, dividing the opening into four.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { border: calc(5px * 6 / @size-col) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: calc(4px * 6 / @size-col); margin-top: calc(-2px * 6 / @size-col); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: calc(4px * 6 / @size-col); margin-left: calc(-2px * 6 / @size-col); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
